description: Get the daily trend for ONE brand trait (attribute), brand and competitors side by side — how mentions of a keyword like 'Affordable' moved over time. Requires an attribute_id: call get_attributes first to discover ids. `positive` selects the observation direction and defaults to true when omitted. Days with no data are returned as zeros, so the series is gap-free and chartable. Denominators are per-side, not the day's whole response set: brand_percentage divides by that day's responses that mention the brand (and had attribute extraction run), and competitor_percentage by responses that mention the tracked competitors. brand_total and competitor_total return those denominators explicitly. Competitor figures aggregate all tracked competitors unless competitor_ids narrows them.

competitor_ids.description: Competitor UUIDs to filter to, as an array even for one id. Omit for all competitors.

end_date.description: End of the date range, inclusive. Date-only values include the UTC day through 23:59:59.999; timestamps keep their exact instant. Accepts YYYY-MM-DD, ISO 8601 timestamps (timezone omitted means UTC), English month names with a four-digit year, and unambiguous numeric dates separated by /, -, or .; ambiguous dates are rejected.

location_ids.description: Location UUIDs to filter to, as an array even for one id. The literal string "no-location" selects responses that ran without a location. Omit for all locations.

models.description: AI models to include, as an array even for one model — e.g. ["chatgpt", "perplexity"]. Omit to include all models.

persona_ids.description: Persona UUIDs to filter to, as an array even for one id. Omit for all personas.

prompt_ids.description: Prompt UUIDs to filter to, as an array even for one id. Omit for all prompts.

prompt_status.description: Filter prompts by tracking status: "active" or "paused". Omit for both.

prompt_tags.description: Prompt tag IDs to filter prompts by, as an array (list tags with get_prompt_tags). Omit for all tags.

prompt_tags_operator.description: How prompt_tags combine: "is_any_of" matches prompts with any listed tag, "has_all_of" only prompts carrying every listed tag.

prompt_type.description: Filter prompts by type: "branded" (mentions the brand) or "non_branded". Omit for both.

schedule_id.description: One schedule: "default" or a custom/archived schedule UUID. Omit for Default, which includes all pre-cutover history and ad hoc runs. The retired "manual" token is accepted as an alias of "default". Schedules cannot be combined.

start_date.description: Start of the date range. Required. Accepts YYYY-MM-DD, ISO 8601 timestamps (timezone omitted means UTC), English month names with a four-digit year, and unambiguous numeric dates separated by /, -, or .; ambiguous dates are rejected.

target_identifiers.description: Target identifier strings to filter to, as an array even for one value. The literal string "no-identifier" selects responses with no target identifier. Omit for all.

variation_filter.description: Which prompt rows to include, as an array: "prompt" for base prompts, "variation" for generated variations, or both. Omit for both.

name: get_attribute_time_series
